game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the knight must hold off goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike. Then check b and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal seal from goblin raiders in Tavern Quarter: keep b above zero until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 10, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
